overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, specialized academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, software releases, and academic recruitment, yielding high engagement across all channels.

contentThemes.description: Posts highlighting publications, conference presentations, and methodology discussions regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Announcements seeking PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers for computational social science projects.
Updates regarding open-source research tools like CooRnet.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to leverage its large follower base and high raw engagement potential for major milestones.
Cross-promote call-for-applications across platforms simultaneously, using interactive prompts on conversational networks like Bluesky.
Incorporate visual elements or links to full research papers to further boost post shareability.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate overall (avg 6.14%), driven by strong repost numbers on research releases and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Solid community reaction to technical updates (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) and methodological discussions among an academic/research-oriented audience.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base generating the highest total likes and comments, particularly effective for major professional updates such as grant awards and recruitment.
